item.title: Anthropic CEO's Ten-Year Cancer Cure Claim Draws Medical Pushback
item.description:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicted AI will make cancer, Alzheimer's and heart disease history within a decade, echoing optimistic timelines from Musk and Hassabis. Drug-industry executives and physicians pushed back, arguing AI can only speed early molecule screening and cannot bypass the 10-12 year clinical trial and regulatory pipeline; as of 2026 no AI-designed drug has reached full clinical use.

原文标题：Anthropic CEO 预测十年攻克癌症遭医学界质疑

Why it matters：头部 AI 公司 CEO 的激进医学预测与产业界实证反驳形成鲜明对照，是理解 AI for Science 边界的重要行业讨论。

item.title: Sinopec Debuts China's First Embodied AI Pressure Gauge Calibration Device
item.description:
Sinopec has led the development of China's first embodied-AI fully automated calibration device for pointer pressure gauges, combining robotic handling, vision-based dial recognition and software-driven judgment. It calibrates four gauges per cycle in five to six minutes, delivering over 3.5x efficiency gains and 99.7% reading accuracy, shifting gauge verification from manual to machine operation. The device will be shown at the third Metrology Instrument Equipment Exhibition on November 18-20.

原文标题：中国石化牵头研发国内首个具身智能压力表检定装置

Why it matters：具身智能在石化工业检测场景的真实落地案例，给出了效率与识别率的具体量化指标。

item.title: 22 Open Source Projects Ban AI-Generated Contributions
item.description:
A tracking site has cataloged 22 open source projects that explicitly ban AI-generated contributions, including immich, Meilisearch, Servo and Gentoo. The policies cover code, tests, documentation and even PR and issue comments, signaling that AI-contribution governance is becoming institutionalized across open source communities.

原文标题：22 个开源项目明确禁止 AI 生成代码贡献

Why it matters：这是开源社区对 AI 生成贡献态度分化的集中样本，对理解 AI 与开源协作规范的碰撞具有参考价值。

item.title: Beijing Court Rules Platform Liable for False AI Content Flagging
item.description:
A Beijing Internet Court disclosed a ruling in which a platform hid a user's original text and muted the account for a day after flagging it as unlabeled AI-generated content. The court held the platform liable for breach of contract, rejecting its refusal to explain the detection algorithm on trade-secret grounds, and ordered the content restored and records deleted. The case establishes that platforms must reasonably explain AI-detection decisions and provide remedies for false positives.

原文标题：北京互联网法院判平台误判 AI 生成内容需担责

Why it matters：首例明确平台 AI 内容识别误判责任的司法判例，直接影响内容平台审核机制设计。

item.title: JD Logistics Launches First Tibet Rail Freight Service for Next-Day Delivery
item.description:
JD Logistics has launched its first rail freight service in Tibet, running from Lhasa to Xining in 20.5 hours and cutting delivery times into and out of the region by about two days, with next-day delivery available outbound. It also introduced a combined air-and-ground service priced over 50% below all-air shipping. The Lhasa smart warehouse uses more than 100 self-developed robots, tripling picking efficiency.

原文标题：京东物流开通西藏铁路班列 出藏快递最快次日达

Why it matters：这是京东物流在高原偏远地区物流基础设施上的实质落地，涉及铁路班列、空陆联运与智能仓机器人，具备具体时效与成本数据。

item.title: China Unveils AI Plus Natural Resources Plan Targeting 2030 Governance Platform
item.description:
China's Ministry of Natural Resources and National Development and Reform Commission issued a joint implementation guideline for AI plus natural resources, setting staged goals: by 2028, build high-quality datasets, large models and agents across spatiotemporal geoinformation, territorial planning, marine, geology and mineral, and forestry sectors; by 2030, integrate an intelligent territorial governance platform with deep AI integration across the full management chain and secure, controllable core technologies. The guideline also outlines five AI pilot platforms and eight demonstration scenarios.

原文标题：两部委发布人工智能+自然资源实施意见 2030 年建成智能治理平台

Why it matters：国家级部委层面明确 AI 与自然资源治理融合的路线图与时间表，对关注 AI 行业落地与政务智能化的读者具有政策信号价值。

item.title: Canon Unveils KrF Lithography Tool with 400 Wafers Per Hour
item.description:
Canon announced it will ship the KrF scanning lithography system FPA-6400ES6a for memory and logic chips in early December 2026, claiming throughput of 400 wafers per hour and a industry-leading 4.0nm overlay accuracy. The tool pairs an ultra-high-acceleration stage with vibration suppression and airflow/temperature control, and extends tolerable wafer warpage to 700μm for 3D stacking and wafer bonding processes.

原文标题：佳能发布 KrF 光刻机 产能达每小时 400 片

Why it matters：成熟制程光刻设备的产能与套刻精度升级，直接关系存储与逻辑芯片制造成本，值得半导体与算力基础设施读者关注。

item.title: Hongguo Short Drama Launches AI Virtual Character Rights Registry
item.description:
Hongguo Short Drama's creator center has launched a virtual-character creation and rights-confirmation feature, letting creators pre-submit likeness, IP or copyright registration materials to obtain a rights record. The platform stresses the record only aids rights retention and risk handling rather than guaranteeing legal cover, extending its October crackdown on homogenized content and mass-reused face models.

原文标题：红果短剧上线 AI 虚拟形象确权功能

Why it matters：这是 AI 生成内容进入短剧工业化生产后，平台侧首次系统性处理虚拟形象权属确权问题，对关注 AIGC 版权与内容治理的读者有参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI to Retire Legacy ChatGPT Voice Modes on December 11
item.description:
OpenAI will remove Advanced Voice Mode and Standard Voice Mode from ChatGPT settings on December 11, 2026, auto-migrating users to GPT-Live, the full-duplex speech model launched in July. OpenAI says voice usage has nearly doubled since GPT-Live shipped, but some paying users complain of interruptions and lost context and threaten to cancel. Real-time video, screen sharing and custom GPT voice chats will temporarily remain on the legacy stack.

原文标题：OpenAI 12 月 11 日停用旧版语音模式全面转向 GPT-Live

Why it matters：这是 OpenAI 语音交互栈的一次代际切换，涉及全双工架构落地与用户反弹，值得关注其后续是否重演 GPT-4o 暂缓退役的剧本。

item.title: Android Studio Rabbit 2 Ships with Support for 40+ Coding Agents
item.description:
Google released Android Studio Rabbit 2 at the 2026 Android Dev Summit, letting developers pick from over 40 ACP-compliant coding agents such as Claude Agent, Codex and Antigravity directly inside the IDE with full toolchain access. Android CLI, the XR emulator and XR Engine Hub also reached stable, while ARCore's Geospatial API now anchors content on tethered XR glasses and smart glasses.

原文标题：Android Studio Rabbit 2 发布 支持接入 40 余款编码智能体

Why it matters：IDE 开放接入多厂商编码智能体，标志移动开发工具链向智能体中立平台演进。

item.title: OpenAI Quarterly Revenue Tops $10 Billion for First Time
item.description:
OpenAI's Q3 revenue surpassed $10 billion for the first time, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter and roughly triple year-ago levels, with annualized revenue around $50 billion. Adjusted operating margin improved from -150% to -109% as the company raises new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation and pushes its IPO to next year.

原文标题：OpenAI 三季度营收首破百亿美元 环比增近 50%

Why it matters：头部大模型公司首次单季营收破百亿美元，是 AI 商业化进程的关键节点。

item.title: Developer Builds Sound Localization System with Claude Code, Pinpointing Source to 40cm
item.description:
Software developer Simon Willison built Beep Locator, a sound localization system, using Claude Code. By leveraging microphone arrays across five devices and time-difference-of-arrival analysis, it pinpointed an indoor beeping source to within roughly 40cm, successfully locating an old carbon monoxide detector hidden in a cardboard box. The project is open-sourced on GitHub, demonstrating AI coding tools' capacity for rapidly building cross-device utility applications.

原文标题：开发者用 Claude Code 打造声源定位系统 精度达 40 厘米

Why it matters：一个由 AI 编程工具驱动的跨设备声源定位实用项目，技术路径清晰且代码开源，对开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Australian STEM Game Challenge Ends After 12 Years Due to Generative AI
item.description:
Australia's STEM Video Game Challenge will hold its final edition in 2026 after 12 years, with organizer ACER citing generative AI's ubiquity for making it hard for judges to verify student authorship and for diverting the contest from its goals. The event did not ban AI outright, permitting limited AI-assisted coding and debugging as long as students documented their usage and submitted gameplay footage and source code.

原文标题：澳大利亚 STEM 游戏挑战赛因生成式 AI 停办

Why it matters：生成式 AI 冲击教育评价体系的标志性案例，反映 AI 对青少年创作与评审机制的实质影响。

item.title: Tencent Launches Yuanbao Search With Ads Separated From Answers
item.description:
Tencent has launched Yuanbao Search, rebuilding the full search pipeline from query understanding and retrieval to ranking and answer generation on top of its Yuanbao LLM, covering the open web, WeChat Official Accounts, Channels and academic literature. Product lead Li Ruizhang said ads are acceptable but must be clearly separated from answers and collapsible, framing the business model around restraint and user judgment.

原文标题：腾讯元宝搜索上线 广告与答案明确区分

Why it matters：大模型重构搜索链路的产品落地，且明确回应 AI 搜索广告与答案边界这一行业共性难题。

item.title: E Ink Upgrades Spectra 6 Color E-Paper to Nine Base Colors
item.description:
E Ink has expanded the base color palette of its Spectra 6 color e-paper platform from six to nine colors, adding orange, cyan and light green to deliver smoother color transitions and reduced pixelation. The nine-color system requires a SoC working alongside E Ink's e-paper TCON, with the first mass-production format being a 10-inch module debuting in Aura-branded smart photo frames.

原文标题：元太 Spectra 6 彩色电子纸升级至九色

Why it matters：彩色电子纸的色彩规格升级，属显示硬件迭代，与 AI 主线关联较弱。

item.title: Uber and DoorDash See Only Hundreds of Agent Orders
item.description:
Uber and DoorDash executives disclosed on earnings calls that AI-agent-initiated orders remain negligible: roughly 500 Uber Eats orders and just 4 ride orders in a single week, versus hundreds of millions of total trips and deliveries, while DoorDash has seen only a few hundred agent orders cumulatively. Both firms continue building their own AI ordering features, underscoring that agent-driven commerce is still at a very early stage.

原文标题：优步 DoorDash 智能体下单仅数百笔

Why it matters：以头部平台的真实订单数据量化智能体在交易场景的落地现状，为判断 Agent 商业化进度提供稀缺的一手参照。

item.title: New York Enacts AI Safety Rules Requiring 72-Hour Incident Reporting
item.description:
New York has opened the registration portal for its RAISE Act, requiring frontier AI developers with over $500 million in annual revenue to register by January 1, 2027, publish safety frameworks and model transparency reports, and report major safety incidents within 72 hours. Violations carry fines of up to $1 million per incident, rising to $3 million for repeat offenses, with the new DIGIT office overseeing enforcement. It marks one of the most binding state-level AI safety regimes in the US to date.

原文标题：纽约州推 AI 安全新规 重大事故须 72 小时上报

Why it matters：美国州级 AI 安全监管首次形成可执行的注册、披露与事故上报闭环，直接影响 OpenAI、Anthropic 等头部实验室的合规路径。

item.title: IDC Forecasts Global Data Center Cabinets to Reach 58 Million by 2030
item.description:
IDC projects global data center cabinets will grow from roughly 25 million in 2026 to 58 million by 2030, with annual energy consumption rising from 519 TWh to 1,308 TWh and facility capex climbing from $276 billion to $655 billion. The report flags power supply, grid interconnection and liquid-cooling delivery cycles as key constraints on AI infrastructure buildout, while China's intelligent compute capacity reached 2,185 EFLOPS with only a 71.4% rack utilization rate, pointing to regional supply-demand mismatches.

原文标题：IDC 预测 2030 年全球数据中心机柜将达 5800 万架

Why it matters：IDC 给出 AI 基础设施物理侧的中长期量化预测，并点明电力与供应链瓶颈，对算力投资判断有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Demand Surges as Valuation Eyes $1.5 Trillion
item.description:
Anthropic's upcoming IPO has drawn such intense investor demand that underwriters are weighing a price hike above the initial $70-78 per share range, potentially lifting its target valuation from $1.4 trillion to over $1.5 trillion and total proceeds beyond $100 billion. Google, Nvidia and Microsoft will invest $26 billion in a concurrent private placement at the IPO price, with the company prioritizing capital for massive compute spending over valuation maximization.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 认购火爆 估值或突破 1.5 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业史上规模最大的 IPO 之一，估值量级与算力军备竞赛的资金逻辑对产业格局判断具有关键参考价值。

item.title: UK Regulator Warns AI Is Undermining University Assessment Integrity
item.description:
England's higher education regulator OfS found that widespread AI use has made it nearly impossible for lecturers to judge whether coursework reflects students' real abilities, with some students openly admitting ChatGPT wrote entire essays undetected. The regulator warned universities could breach registration conditions if assessments are not reformed, urging a sharp increase in AI-free exams and live presentations.

原文标题：英国监管机构警告 AI 让大学作业考核失效

Why it matters：监管机构首次以办学合规为杠杆施压高校改革考核方式，是 AI 冲击教育评估体系的标志性事件。

item.title: TSMC Approves Up to $1B Investment in Anthropic and OpenAI
item.description:
TSMC's board approved up to $1 billion in AI investments, subscribing up to $500M of Anthropic common stock at its IPO price and up to $500M of OpenAI preferred shares. The move extends TSMC beyond advanced-node manufacturing into model-layer capital stakes, as Anthropic launches an IPO at $70-78 per share targeting over $61 billion in proceeds.

原文标题：台积电批准向 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 投资 10 亿美元

Why it matters：头部晶圆代工厂以基石投资者身份入股两大模型厂商，折射 AI 供应链上下游边界加速融合。

item.title: 腾讯元宝搜索上线 接入 157 个权威信源
item.description:
腾讯正式上线 AI 搜索产品「元宝搜索」，基于元宝大模型重构理解、检索、排序到答案生成的完整链路，覆盖全网网页、公众号、视频号及学术文献。产品接入 157 个权威信源，将广告与答案明确区分并支持整块折叠，同时引入递归自我进化机制持续优化体验。

Why it matters：腾讯以自研大模型切入搜索赛道，打通公众号与视频号独家内容池，是 AI 搜索格局的重要变量。

item.title: 亚马逊 Ring 发布飞行与轮式安防机器人
item.description:
亚马逊旗下 Ring 扩展 Ring Robotics 产品线，推出面向家庭的飞行摄像头 Drone Cam 与面向商铺的轮式机器人 Rover Cam。两款设备均搭载 AI Pilot 系统，结合视觉模型与云端处理实现自主建图、避障与巡逻，Rover Cam 售价 999.99 美元，Drone Cam 售价 249.99 美元。

Why it matters：这是消费级具身智能在安防场景的一次具体产品落地，AI Pilot 自主导航方案与定价值得关注。

item.title: 百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 280B 模型并承诺开源权重
item.description:
百度文心发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview，这是 Base 模型的首个后训练版本，总参数 280B、激活参数 14B，支持 1M 上下文，主打编程、3D 建模与内容创作场景。模型 API 已在千帆平台上线，权重将于 11 月 25 日前开源，官方称其为后训练中间版本，正式版仍在快速迭代。

Why it matters：国产大模型以 280B 总参数、14B 激活的稀疏架构切入 1M 上下文赛道，并承诺两周内开源权重，对开源生态与国产模型选型均有实质影响。

item.title: 国产太阳能无人机轻骑兵完成首飞 设计续航 30 小时
item.description:
中国航天科技集团十一院宣布，商用级中小型纯太阳能无人机“轻骑兵”在西北某机场完成首飞，翼展 8 米、设计续航 30 小时，支持车载起飞与模块化载荷。该机以太阳能为唯一动力源，面向应急通信与临时监测场景，标志国内太阳能无人机从技术验证迈向商用产品，但载荷重量、巡航速度等关键参数尚未披露。

Why it matters：国产太阳能无人机首次以商用产品形态完成首飞，是低空经济与长航时无人平台的重要节点。

item.title: DEEPX 2nm 边缘 AI 芯片完成流片 5W 功耗支持 10B 模型
item.description:
韩国边缘 AI 芯片公司 DEEPX 宣布，其基于三星 2nm 工艺的 DX-M2 已完成光罩流片，集成 80 TOPS NPU，支持 128bit LPDDR5X-9600 内存，可在 5W 功耗下本地运行 10B 参数以上的 LLM 与 VLM，实物芯片预计 2027 年初面世。该芯片同时获得 CES 2027 人工智能类别创新奖。

Why it matters：2nm 工艺加 5W 功耗跑 10B 级模型，是边缘端大模型推理硬件的重要节点，流片进展具备实质参考价值。

item.title: 北京出台具身智能三年行动方案 培育 200 家中小企业
item.description:
北京市经信局印发《北京市具身智能机器人产业高质量发展行动方案（2026-2028 年）》，提出建立具身智能机器人企业上市“一对一”服务机制，培育优势龙头企业。方案明确在整机、关键零部件、具身智能模型和数据采集等领域培育不少于 200 家科技型与专精特新企业，并支持 VLA、世界模型、强化学习等多技术路线融合创新。

Why it matters：地方政府以三年行动方案形式明确具身智能产业培育目标与上市服务机制，是观察产业政策走向的实质信号。

item.title: Nordic 发布 nRF71 系列 Wi-Fi SoC 待机功耗降低 1/20
item.description:
Nordic Semiconductor 推出 nRF71 系列 Wi-Fi SoC，内置 Axon NPU，可在芯片上直接执行关键词检测、异常检测与图像分类等边缘 AI 推理，无需外挂 AI 处理器。该系列包含支持双频 Wi-Fi 6 的 nRF7120 与三频 Wi-Fi 6E 的 nRF7120E，均集成低功耗蓝牙、Thread 与 Matter，待机功耗较 nRF70 最高降低 1/20。

Why it matters：面向物联网终端的 Wi-Fi SoC 首次集成专用 NPU，是边缘 AI 硬件下沉的典型信号。

item.title: Anthropic 拟 IPO 估值 1.3 万亿美元 七位创始人各套现 2.5 亿美元
item.description:
据 WSJ 报道，Anthropic 计划下周上市，估值接近 1.3 万亿美元，募资规模达 800 亿美元以上，其中部分通过向 Google 等投资者的私募配售完成。七位创始人每人将出售约 250 万美元等值股票，各自保留约 180 亿美元持仓，并通过持有单一 Class F 股的创始人控制 LLC 锁定 50.1% 投票权，使公开市场投资者几乎无法影响公司控制权。

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业迄今规模最大的 IPO 事件，涉及万亿美元估值、创始人巨额套现与特殊投票权结构，对产业格局与投资判断具有实质影响。
